method: Read source with standard library only

findings.fact: The test imports real rouge.capture before setUp. This requires real win32gui/win32process/win32api/win32con plus local FrameBuffer and its cv2/numpy imports. No GameCapture constructor or local native window enumeration is called at module import.

Every patch is started and cleanup registered before real GameCapture is constructed and connect is called. Patches replace list_game_windows, windows_capture.WindowsCapture, frame_client_rect, win32gui.IsWindow and IsIconic. This is an explicit fake boundary, not a native capture test.

connect uses the fake window list and creates FakeWGC. Event decorators register functions in a dict; FakeWGC.start_free_threaded returns Mock without starting a capture thread. Synthetic arrays are fed directly into callbacks and local FrameBuffer. Real process_names/EnumWindows/frame_client_rect ctypes native calls are bypassed by patches.

The invoked local constructors create locks and in-memory buffer state. Cleanup closes the fake session, clears memory and calls the fake Mock.stop; no output files or private paths appear in these methods.

patch("windows_capture.WindowsCapture", FakeWGC) must import the actual external windows_capture package to resolve the attribute before replacing it. The installed external package import/startup behavior was not audited or executed. Real Windows dependency import is therefore a prerequisite, and local Source cannot certify external import side effects.

The image-replay modules define ROOT via Path.resolve and test classes; they do not load images or instantiate ScreenReader at import. Capture unittest.main is under __name__ == "__main__" and does not run during selector imports. No test class decorators or custom metaclasses are present.

Bodies read samples/native-client PNGs using np.fromfile/cv2.imdecode, resize or relocate arrays and call the actual ScreenReader. No fake OCR is installed and no temp path redirection is used. The samples are replay prerequisites; they are not live game/desktop captures.
These names are literal Source requirements. File availability and image validity were not tested in this Source-only audit.

ScreenReader construction initializes memory/cache. First valid read imports and constructs real RapidOCR, with two intra/inter-op threads, then may construct the actual page router/OCR wrappers. External OCR/model initialization behavior remains outside this local Source audit.

The package __init__ is empty. Local startup evaluation consists of function/class creation, standard-library lru_cache/staticmethod decorators, memory ContextVar, Path value construction, literal comprehension work and class-level np.sqrt arithmetic. No local top-level catalog/data reads, GameCapture/ScreenReader instantiation or desktop/chat backend construction was found.

Read-time helper paths point to packaged rouge/data JSON/icon/feature assets. PageFeatureRouter default directory is rouge/data/page-features and np.load explicitly sets allow_pickle=False. This closure contains no settings/run/account/chat-state reader or writer, and no desktop/chat/project-GUI import. Asset prerequisites and external OCR models are still required.

Offline held-item matching can create a bounded ThreadPoolExecutor during a method call. It runs local OpenCV reference matching inside a with block; this is not native capture and does not occur at local module import. Actual execution/cleanup was not measured.

The three original test classes declare no skip decorators, skipTest or environment guards. Missing dependencies/fixtures are errors with the plain unittest runner. verify_full_available separately records missing native-client fixtures as unavailable, also supports selected dependency names; unavailable is not PASS. numpy, cv2 and win32con are not names in that wrapper dependency allow-list, so their absence is an ordinary error under the current wrapper.
